title: Alcoholics Anonymous (2nd Edition)
description: The 1955 second edition of Alcoholics Anonymous. Public domain in the United States — copyright lapsed 1983 (not renewed).

title: Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions
description: Bill W.'s 1953 essays expanding on the Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions. Copyright status pending verification — showing short excerpts only.

title: The Twelve Traditions (Long Form)
description: The long form of the Twelve Traditions, derived from the public-domain 2nd-edition Big Book back matter (pp. 189–191). The same text also appears in the Big Book source. First published in the April/May 1946 AA Grapevine.

title: Daily Reflections
description: Daily Reflections: A Book of Reflections by A.A. Members for A.A. Members. © Alcoholics Anonymous World Services, Inc. Concordance-only excerpts.

title: The Twelve Steps
description: The Twelve Steps as printed in the public-domain 2nd-edition Big Book (Chapter 5, pp. 80–81). The same text also appears in the Big Book source.

title: The Twelve Concepts for World Service
description: The Twelve Concepts for World Service. Under copyright review: the aa.org short form carries a © 1962 AAWS notice and the long form is in the copyrighted A.A. Service Manual, so no reproduction basis is recorded. Disabled — no text is rendered or indexed.

title: The Promises and Step Prayers
description: The Ninth Step Promises and the Third and Seventh Step prayers, derived from the public-domain 2nd-edition Big Book (pp. 83–84, 97, 104–105). The same text also appears in the Big Book source. The Eleventh Step prayer is not included.
